name: Harlequin
author: E. T. Carter
description: A cut-crystal mandala of hard, flat facets. Where the rest of the family blurs, this keeps knife-sharp mirror seams: the folded field is quantised into diamond facets, each flat-shaded a single jewel hue with a bright bevel glinting at its edges. Inner and outer rings counter-rotate, so the diamond pattern shears and reshuffles as the stone slowly turns.

params.label: Segments
params.effect: Number of mirror-fold wedges (floored in-shader) — sets the facet count around the ring.

params.label: Facet rings
params.effect: Concentric rings of facets from the crystal table out to the rim.

params.label: Counter-spin
params.effect: Speed the inner and outer rings counter-rotate; at 0 the stone holds still and only shimmers.

params.label: Bevel
params.effect: Sharpness and width of the bright facet bevels — low for fat soft edges, high for fine cut glints.
